report.summary:
Ready for human review/merge: PR #14 https://github.com/paxxie2/b5-off-site-pnl/pull/14 (branch agent/reject-reverse-window-4-10b8b5256d30, head 78c4418, base main, MERGEABLE/CLEAN, 1 file, +7/-1) closes issue #13's request. `previous_window(start, end)` in backend/app/domain/money.py now raises an explicit ValueError when start > end, before deriving a window; legal single-day, same-month, cross-month, leap-year, non-leap February, leap-day and cross-year windows are unchanged. Only money.py changed, as required.

Verification actually run:
- Stdlib-only acceptance mirror outside the repo (/tmp/b5-pw-accept-10b8b525/hidden_mirror.py): 8 legal windows with expectations independently recomputed via datetime.date arithmetic, plus 5 reversed windows at day/month/year/leap-day boundaries.
- Fixed real Git baseline 1e166fb (git archive): 3/3 runs failed with `AssertionError: DID NOT RAISE ValueError for reversed window 2026-09-02 > 2026-09-01` — target assertion failure, not import/dependency failure.
- Committed head 78c4418 (git archive): 3/3 runs passed.
- `uv run --offline python -m pytest backend/tests/test_money.py backend/tests/test_pnl.py backend/tests/test_rules.py backend/tests/test_scenarios.py -q`: 49 passed.
- `git diff --check` clean; working tree clean; remote head matches 78c4418.

Pre-existing limitation: full backend/tests cannot collect test_db.py/test_seed.py and DB-backed API fixtures because backend/app/data is absent at baseline (`data/` gitignored), `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.data'`; confirmed on baseline archive, unrelated and outside allowed scope.

No UI change, so no before/after visual evidence applies. No CI configured (statusCheckRollup empty), no branch protection/review rules, no review requests and no reviews yet. Automated-reviewer rounds: 0; credited reviewers: none. This deployment names no merge CLI, so auto-merge was not enabled and a person must merge. Duplicate note: open PRs #3, #6, #8, #10 and #12 propose the identical change; only one should be merged.
